name: Schneider National, Inc.
summary: Schneider National, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides multimodal surface transportation and logistics solutions in the United States, Canada, and Mexico. It operates in three segments: Truckload, Intermodal, and Logistics. The Truckload segment offers over-the-road freight transportation services through dry van, bulk, temperature-controlled, lightweight, and flatbed trailers across dedicated or network configurations. Its Intermodal segment provides door-to-door container on flat car services through a combination of rail and dray transportation using company-owned containers, chassis, and trucks.
